title: P49: submitMessage protocol byte is on the wire
description: protocol-06 §5.4 declares 'Protocol protocol;' explicitly in SubmitMessageRequest and SubmitMessageResponse (L1533, L1587), so P8 (mimid-1wgh.5.23, protocol from context for selects lacking a field) does not apply; the byte is encoded and decoded, matching keyMaterial and groupInfo.
